name: Neolix
about: Chinese maker / operator of low-speed autonomous delivery and retail vehicles. They are material in China for goods autonomy and purpose-built unmanned vehicles.
model: Vehicle sales, leasing, delivery services, and fleet operation partnerships.
deployment: Autonomous delivery vehicles deployed in Chinese cities and campus/park environments; exact live fleet to verify.
metrics: 16,000+ autonomous delivery vehicles deployed across 15 countries; largest single deployment is Qingdao with 1,200+ vehicles via a DiDi Freight partnership.
signal: Neolix is a useful long-tail node where AV manufacturing, delivery operations, and smart-city policy intersect.
